patch_description: Crossover of the PathPlanner-based approach and the trunk-reuse (alpha discount) approach. The new program: (1) builds a valid-graph restricted to known-cost edges plus a full graph with median-filled None costs for candidate discovery (from the PathPlanner parent); (2) processes destinations in descending order of baseline cost so expensive routes build shared trunks first (from the alpha-discount parent); (3) scores candidate paths with a reuse discount on edges already used by other destinations, encouraging shared edges that reduce redundant transfers; (4) adopts a path only if its true valid cost never exceeds the Dijkstra baseline, guaranteeing it is never worse than all prior programs; (5) retains the safe full-graph fallback when cost filtering disconnects a destination. Interface (inputs/outputs) is unchanged.
